description: Turn the things the user wants for themself into one giftgenius.io wish list page: each thing named clearly with a link to find it, grouped by price. The people the page is sent to can mark "I'm getting this", so nobody buys the same thing twice. Pass 1 to 12 things in the user's words, each with any color, size, model or price range they gave. Entries that are not things to buy are left off and returned in "skipped". The list has no name on it and no account.

items.description: The 1 to 12 things the user wants for themself, one entry each.

budget.description: The price range the user wants it in, if they gave one: under-25, 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus.

details.description: Color, size, model or what it is for, if the user said (max 200 characters).

item.description: One thing the user wants, in a few words, e.g. "label maker" or "wool running socks".

occasion.description: What the wish list is for. Omit when there is no occasion.

name: make_wish_list

builder_url.description: The Wishlist Builder on giftgenius.io, for getting ideas of what to ask for.

items.description: The things on the list, as named there.

why.description: What the thing is, with the details passed.

skipped.description: Entries left off the list because they are not things that can be bought online, as passed.

wishlist_url.description: The wish list on giftgenius.io: each thing with a link to find it, and a way for people it is sent to to mark what they are getting.

title: Make a wish list
